mode.description: "list" — discover the user's AOPs (name/id/hasPlaybook/isNoOp/selectionProcedure/customAssignmentInstruction/orgAssignmentInstruction/effectiveAssignmentInstruction), optionally filtered by aopName. "load_full" — read the full PLAYBOOK.md for one AOP, plus its org-level playbook (`orgPlaybook`) if one exists, plus an `editMap`: every referenced subagent/resource and each inline PLAYBOOK.md surface, tagged with `source` (user|org) + `writeTarget`. To edit playbook behavior, write to a target's `writeTarget` — do NOT choose user-vs-org scope by hand. "load_sections" — read only the named sections of one AOP's playbook (and the same sections of its org-level playbook if one exists), plus the same `editMap` (requires `sections`).

aopId.description: Explicit AOP ID to target for load_full/load_sections. Omit to use the conversation currently in context, or resolve by aopName instead.

aopName.description: AOP name to target instead of aopId (e.g. "Deals"). For mode="list", filters the returned list (case-insensitive; no match returns an empty list, not an error). For load_full/load_sections, resolves to an aopId via list-aops (case-insensitive exact match, then substring) — if nothing matches, the call fails explicitly rather than silently falling back to the conversation in context.

sections.description: Required for mode="load_sections". Section header names (without the "## " prefix) to extract, e.g. ["Stages", "Objection Handling"]. Each is matched independently and the results are concatenated.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: read another org member's playbook (theirs, not yours) — pass their userId. When set, mode="list" returns THAT member's AOPs (use it to find their aopId), and load_full/load_sections read their playbook. Pass an explicit aopId/aopName alongside it; the conversation-in-context fallback is yours, not theirs. Omit to read your own. Rejected for non-admins or a target outside your org.
Org owner/admin only: target a same-org member. Omit for self; non-admins and cross-org targets are rejected.

userId.description: DEPRECATED alias for targetUserId. Same authorization gate; prefer targetUserId.

sections.description: Which sections to load. "data_services" returns provider defaults, policy origins, versions, watcher defaults and credential availability (never secrets). "connections" returns the connectionId required by apply-change's CRM/Slack change types — call this before apply-change whenever you need one and don't already have it. "user_settings" includes agentExecutionEnabled/pushDraftsToExternalClient for visibility, but neither is settable from any tool: they are not fields on any apply-change change type, and agentExecutionEnabled is additionally writable only by Cedar staff. Report them; never try to change them. "inboxes" returns custom inbox tabs, layout, and shared inboxSortingInstructions (read before changing sorting preferences or managing inbox tabs). "task_groups" returns the task lanes (get group ids before a manage_task_group update/delete/reorder). "credentials" returns the stored credential entries this user can reach (own + org): name, scope, instructions and which FIELD NAMES are stored. Never values.

aopId.description: A user AOP id. Always returns both this AOP's own fields and its linked org AOP's fields, if any.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: target a same-org member user AOP (scope=user). Omit for self; non-admins and cross-org targets are rejected.

targetUserIds.description: View MANY reps at once instead of just yourself — orthogonal to `targetUserId` above (that names ONE teammate to act as; this names a SET to view). Omit for your own fields only (unchanged default). An explicit array of userIds, or the literal "org" for every rep on this SAME AOP type — every user AOP linked to the same org AOP as `aopId`, not everyone in the organization. Naming anyone other than yourself requires org-admin authorization (aop_field:org) and is refused otherwise.

rollup.description: true summarizes across every targeted rep — uniform/diverging/missing per field key, vs. the org default — instead of returning each rep's raw field list. Defaults to false when exactly one rep is targeted (returns the same flat field list as omitting `targetUserIds` entirely), true when more than one is. Pass explicitly to override either default.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on a member's name OR email. Omit to list everyone.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the channel name. Omit to list everything.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
